items.title: The outlook for molybdenum: a hard 26,400-tonne deficit, and why its elasticity is so striking
items.summary: The reason molybdenum's price elasticity is striking is not scarcity - global reserves-to-production is 65 years and China's is 80, so it is not scarce at all - but that its supply curve is almost vertical: about 70% of global molybdenum comes as a by-product of copper-molybdenum ore, so output is set by copper mining plans and is unrelated to the molybdenum price itself
items.title_zh: 钼的未来展望：2.64万吨硬性缺口，为什么它的弹性如此惊人？
items.summary_zh: 钼的价格弹性之所以"惊人"，不是因为它稀缺——全球储采比 65 年、中国 80 年，它一点都不稀缺——而是因为它的供给曲线几乎是垂直的：全球 70% 的钼来自铜钼伴生矿的副产品，产量由铜的采选计划决定，与钼价本身无关
